user_reported_gameplay_observations.scope: Queued +50000, ATM trigger; user confirmed money retained after restart. Other features remain unverified.

UI4 checkbox + ARM gate + OnUpdate-reapplied ActivateInvincibility survived a scripted guaranteed-death transformer explosion point-blank. Ammo/focus/police and all unlock batches remain unverified; invincibility is a session effect.
Native panel infinite battery confirmed working by user. Combined with native.cash_add and lua.god, three features are now user-verified; all other candidates remain unverified individually.
PING notification appeared (proves button actions execute) but panel Clicks text did not change; host Layout likely renders once, so counters moved to the notification channel in 0.4.1.

All four online-gated weapons (SG-90, Spec Ops Vector, OCP-11, MP-9mm) granted locally via AddItem and visible in-game. Online-gated INVENTORY unlocks are now user-verified. Progression counters (skill/XP/APS tokens) showed no visible effect via AddItem; native resources-capture path (+9C/+A0/+A8 same object) is the prescribed route.

Native panel same-capture growth: skill point +1 and XP increase both applied and persisted after save+restart. Counters route is now user-proven; money_floor/skill_floor toggles on the same capture are the next candidates.
Reward item granted, saved, restarted: car not present in Car On Demand. Item grants do not produce delivery-car unlocks; permanent unlock requires the native path.
Online mode cannot be entered with the host/tool installed. User accepts offline-only usage. Safety guidance: never enter online with effects active regardless.

User clarified the unlock restart-check was not actually performed; the recorded negative conclusion was premature and has been reverted. 0.4.7 adds a 7-car unlock test batch (Livraga LE, Sayonara, Sayonara LE, Boxberg LE, Boxberg R1, Papavero, Papavero Stealth Edition); verdict pending the proper grant->save->restart->Car On Demand check.

Spawn buttons cannot summon locked/LE cars (all refused); only 3 already-owned cars spawned. Confirms spawn is a temporary summon gated by ownership, not an unlock. Permanent unlock path remains: [ALL CARS]/CAR UNLOCK TEST -> CONFIRM -> save -> full restart -> Car On Demand check.
